description: Localise the AcrIF3 structural similarity within PA14 Cas8f: N-region versus C-terminal helical bundle
code:
import requests, numpy as np, time
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0"})
AA3={'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL','MSE'}
def parse(t):
    L=t.splitlines(); i=0; cols=[]; rows=[]; n=len(L)
    while i<n:
        if L[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            while i<n and L[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(L[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            while i<n:
                ln=L[i]
                if ln.startswith('#') or ln.startswith('loop_') or ln.startswith('_') or ln.strip()=='': break
                rows.append(ln.split()); i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}; return idx,[r for r in rows if len(r)==len(cols)]
def cas(pid,chain):
    idx,recs=parse(S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=200).text)
    d={}
    for r in recs:
        if r[idx['auth_asym_id']]==chain and r[idx['label_atom_id']]=='CA' and r[idx['label_comp_id']] in AA3:
            d[int(r[idx['auth_seq_id']])]=[float(r[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_z']])]
    ks=sorted(d); return np.array(ks), np.array([d[k] for k in ks])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,s,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); return V@np.diag([1,1,dd])@Wt,pc,qc
def app(X,R,pc,qc): return (X-pc)@R+qc
def dp_align(Sm,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=Sm.shape; H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1): H[i,0]=H[i-1,0]+gap; P[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): H[0,j]=H[0,j-1]+gap; P[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=Sm[i-1]; Hi=H[i]; Hi1=H[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=Hi1[j-1]+s[j-1]; b=Hi1[j]+gap; c=Hi[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Hi[j]=a; P[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Hi[j]=b; P[i,j]=1
            else: Hi[j]=c; P[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    pr.reverse(); return pr
def search(Q,T,kt,label,nseed=25,FL=10):
    Lq=len(Q); Lmin=min(Lq,len(T)); d0=max(0.5,1.24*(Lmin-15)**(1/3)-1.8)
    tree=cKDTree(T); cands=[]
    for i in range(0,Lq-FL,2):
        P0=Q[i:i+FL]
        for j in range(0,len(T)-FL,2):
            R,pc,qc=kabsch(P0,T[j:j+FL])
            d,_=tree.query(app(Q,R,pc,qc)); cands.append((int((d<5.0).sum()),R,pc,qc))
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0]); best=(0,None)
    for n0,R,pc,qc in cands[:nseed]:
        for it in range(4):
            M=app(Q,R,pc,qc); D=np.linalg.norm(M[:,None,:]-T[None,:,:],axis=2)
            pr=dp_align(1.0/(1.0+(D/d0)**2))
            if len(pr)<8: break
            pi=np.array([p[0] for p in pr]); pj=np.array([p[1] for p in pr])
            dd=D[pi,pj]; sel=dd<8.0
            if sel.sum()<8: break
            R,pc,qc=kabsch(Q[pi[sel]],T[pj[sel]]); M=app(Q,R,pc,qc)
            dv=np.linalg.norm(M[pi]-T[pj],axis=1)
            tm=(1.0/(1.0+(dv/d0)**2)).sum()/Lmin
            if tm>best[0]:
                best=(tm,int((dv<5).sum()),float(np.sqrt((dv[dv<5]**2).mean())),sorted(set(kt[pj[dv<5]].tolist())))
    print(f"{label}: TM(norm. by shorter chain, L={Lmin}) = {best[0]:.3f}; pairs<5A = {best[1]}; RMSD {best[2]:.2f} A")
    print(f"    matched target residues: {best[3][:5]} ... {best[3][-5:]}  (range {best[3][0]}-{best[3][-1]})")
    return best

t0=time.time()
kq,Q=cas("5GNF","A")
kt,T=cas("6NE0","A")
print("PA14 Cas8f modelled range:", kt.min(), "-", kt.max(), "n=",len(kt))
res={}
res["full Cas8f (11-426)"]=search(Q,T,kt,"AcrIF3 vs full Cas8f")
m1=kt<250; m2=kt>=250
res["Cas8f N-region (11-249)"]=search(Q,T[m1],kt[m1],"AcrIF3 vs Cas8f 11-249")
res["Cas8f C-terminal bundle (250-426)"]=search(Q,T[m2],kt[m2],"AcrIF3 vs Cas8f 250-426")
print("elapsed",time.time()-t0)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3.4))
labs=list(res); vals=[res[l][0] for l in labs]
ax.barh(range(len(labs)),vals,color=["#2E6F95","#8FC1D4","#C8553D"])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(labs))); ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(0.5,ls="--",color="0.3"); ax.set_xlabel("TM-score (normalised by the shorter chain)")
ax.set_title("Which part of Cas8f does AcrIF3 resemble?",fontsize=11)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
